slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.09% today to 7,659.44, dragged down by a sharp selloff in technology stocks. The Nasdaq 100 dropped 2.50%, its worst single day in weeks, as rising oil prices, a hot wholesale inflation reading, and growing doubts about AI company debt loads all hit at once. Fear in the market, measured by the VIX which tracks how nervous investors are, jumped 21.45% to 19.99. Earnings season starts in earnest next week with NFLX, META, TSLA, IBM and GOOG all reporting.
